bundle.shortDescription: Android Toolkit for Developers — ADB, FRP, System Diagnostics
bundle.longDescription: DroidKit is an enterprise-grade cross-platform Android toolkit providing ADB file management, app management, logcat streaming, system diagnostics, wireless pairing, emulator control, and advanced Android system utilities for developers and enterprises.
